title: rosa dumalis f. fraxinoides
intro: Rosa dumalis f. fraxinoides, commonly known as Rosa fragrans, is a fragrant and flowering plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rosa dumalis f. fraxinoides include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and antiseptic, making it useful for wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
